title: SystemLimitation
description: A system-capability or input-accessibility issue. references/00-contracts.md §6.3. Carries no severity — it is not a manuscript issue. It lowers extraction_coverage and confidence, not manuscript_risk_score. It must not be converted into a manuscript defect without independent manuscript evidence.

impact.description: Explains which parts of the review are incomplete as a result, i.e. 'where we could not see clearly'

affected_modules.description: May be an empty array: when the impact surface is not yet certain

affected_targets.description: Affected entities, e.g. fig:4B / table:2 / S1

affected_fields.description: Field paths judged parse_failed because of this

evidence_refs.description: May be an empty array — cases like input_truncated have nothing to point at

recommended_action.description: How to regain visibility, e.g. 'obtain the original high-resolution figure or vector PDF and re-parse'

not.description: system_limitation must not carry a severity, nor produce manual review actions (that is the finding's responsibility)

allOf.description: External-source-failure limitations may only be produced by X1
